method: Each manifest variant is rebuilt as a pigment RenderPlan (+ PlanExtensions) from the same input fixtures (inputs/*.tif through hsk-studio-interop-tiff; 16-bit documents hold the 8-bit fixtures on Photoshop's 15-bit scale; the 32-bit exposure input is Photoshop's own 32bit_identity output; circle and soft shapes come from the PS-C17 outputs whose light Screen glow over white leaves the shape unchanged) and rendered by hsk-studio-render-cpu execute_extended in the encoded blend space (Photoshop's default document blending). Studio's straight RGBA is stored as Photoshop stored the TIFF (premultiplied with alpha when exported with transparency, otherwise flattened onto white) and compared per sample.
tolerance: 8-bit: |studio rounded to 8 bits - oracle| <= 1 code; 16-bit: <= 4 steps of Photoshop's 15-bit scale (studio unquantised); 32-bit float: <= 1e-4. Dissolve at partial coverage: statistical (every pixel backdrop or source within 1 code; source share within 0.02).

row_findings.PS-03: blend modes: all 27 Photoshop modes MATCH the 16-bit grid and 26 of 27 the 8-bit opacity-100 and opacity-50 grids (dissolve through the statistical check); vivid light at 8 bit stays within 2 codes (Photoshop's 8-bit integer path). Before this lane colour/luminosity produced NaN on gray inputs, vivid light had wrong end points and hard mix a wrong tie on b + s = 1 (all fixed, cited to PS-B01). Fill 50 on the special-eight modes diverges by up to 128 codes (FP-SPECIAL8-FILL); fill on the other 19 modes matches the product rule.
row_findings.PS-01: opacity and normal-group compositing match (PS-B01 o50 grid, PS-C01 group over transparency, PS-C11 nested groups); fill on non-special modes matches the product rule.
row_findings.PS-04: mask density matches (d100/d50); feather unproven (oracle defect: feather key not applied).
row_findings.PS-06: clip-to-base rule matches where Studio admits it (PS-C18 no Blend-If, PS-C22 clipped invert, PS-C20 interior); Blend-If on clip roles is refused, the oracle now defines it (FP-BLENDIF-CLIP-ROLES).
row_findings.PS-07: curves (natural cubic spline) exact on 4 curves incl. the installed Strong Contrast and Negative ACVs; levels exact for gamma <= 1 and channel-then-composite order confirmed, gamma > 1 differs near black (FP-LEVELS-GAMMA-TOE); hue/saturation within 1 code except sat+50 (2 codes); legacy brightness/contrast within 1 code after FIX-BC-LEGACY-PIVOT, modern refused; exposure exact at 32 bit (1.2e-7) and within 1 code at 8 bit except ev+1 (2 codes); invert in a group over transparency exact; threshold exact after FIX-THRESHOLD-ROUNDING; posterize within 1 code.
row_findings.PS-09: layer effects diverge in the blur kernel: Photoshop's Softer blur is a separable tent of half-width = size (reproduced within 0.5 code) with offsets rounded half away from zero; Studio uses Gaussian sigma = size/2 (FP-EFFECT-KERNEL). Hard parts match: inside strokes, choke-100 inner shadows at axis angles, straight stroke edges. Interior effects raise alpha on anti-aliased edges (FP-INTERIOR-EFFECT-ALPHA); stroke corner arcs differ (FP-STROKE-CORNER-AA).
row_findings.PS-11: Blend-If uses inclusive integer ramps on a rounded gray (FP-BLENDIF-INTEGER-RAMP); an Underlying range over a transparent group backdrop hides nothing in Photoshop (FP-BLENDIF-TRANSPARENT-UNDERLYING).
row_findings.PS-12: knockout unproven (oracle defect: knockout key not applied).
row_findings.PS-26: 32-bit linear exposure exact; 16-bit documents behave as 15-bit (input quantisation reproduces the colour burn/dodge/divide grids). 16-bit Lab encoding settled: full range, neutral a/b at 32768 (FIX-LAB16-AB-OFFSET); Lab -> SWOP CMYK through Prism differs from ACE by up to 6.5 codes (FP-CMS-ACE-PARITY).

fixes.evidence: PS-B01 colour/luminosity on gray inputs: Studio produced NaN on 42 (8-bit) / 9 (16-bit) of 65536 pixels (0/0 when the binary32 SetLum result is an all-equal gray just below 0); a non-positive denominator now returns the gray itself, the W3C limit.
PS-B01 vivid light 8 and 16 bit: Photoshop returns 0 at source 0 and 1 at source 1 for every backdrop; Studio returned 1 at (b 1, s 0) and 0 at (b 0, s 1).
PS-B01 hard mix 8/16 bit and opacity 50: on the b + s = 1 diagonal Photoshop gives 0 for a source above 0.5 and 1 below (128 pixels); tie band 1e-6.
PS-C07: Photoshop thresholds round(255 lum) >= level (0 mismatches on the 17^3 lattice and the 127/128/129 ramps); Studio's lum >= level/255 missed 15 lattice pixels and the gray-127 equality.
